faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about setting up your business in Dubai.

items.q: Why should someone set up a mainland business in the UAE?
items.a: The UAE is a prime destination offering myriad business opportunities. Location of target market and business activities should guide the choice between Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

items.q: How can a foreigner start a business in Dubai?
items.a: The CCL permits 100% foreign ownership. Steps: determine entity type, select company name, apply for a business license, get pre-approvals, register your business, and get your license.

items.q: What is the best free zone to open a company in Dubai?
items.a: Key factors include location, chosen business activities, and office space requirements. Contact our experts to find the perfect fit.

items.q: Which business license should I choose?
items.a: It depends on your business activity, office requirements, visa needs and budget. Contact us and we’ll help you identify the suitable option.

items.q: Do I need an office for a Mainland company?
items.a: A physical office or business premises is generally required, subject to the activity and applicable regulations.

items.q: Do I need an office for a Free Zone company?
items.a: Our available Free Zone packages can be established without a physical office. Requirements vary depending on the Free Zone and package.

items.q: Can I get a Free Zone license without a residence visa?
items.a: Yes, selected packages can be issued without a residence visa.

items.q: How many investor visas can I get with a Free Zone company?
items.a: Visa capacity depends on the Free Zone and selected package and can reach up to 10 investor visas in applicable packages.

items.q: Can I open a company as a Freelancer?
items.a: Eligible professionals may be able to obtain a Freelance license depending on their activity and qualifications.

items.q: Can you handle my visa after setting up the company?
items.a: Yes. We provide visa and immigration-related services as part of our business support.

items.q: Do you provide license renewal services?
items.a: Yes. We assist with license renewal and various license amendments.

Mainland.title: Mainland Company Setup
Mainland.subtitle: Mainland company setup in Dubai and the UAE is quick & hassle-free, with 100% ownership for most activities.
Mainland.p1: The UAE is recognised as a prime destination for foreign investors seeking to establish a presence in the Middle East. Mainland company formation allows you to trade directly with the local UAE market, bid on government tenders, and operate without geographic restrictions — all while enjoying 100% foreign ownership for the majority of business activities following recent regulatory reforms.
Mainland.p2: Whether you are launching a commercial, industrial, or professional venture, a mainland license gives you the flexibility to operate across all seven emirates and internationally, making it the most versatile jurisdiction for ambitious businesses.

benefits.title: 100% Foreign Ownership
benefits.description: Retain full ownership of your business without requiring a local sponsor for most activities.

benefits.title: No Corporate / Personal Tax
benefits.description: Benefit from the UAE's tax-free environment on personal and corporate income.

benefits.title: Trade Freely Anywhere in the UAE
benefits.description: Operate across all emirates and access the entire local consumer market without restriction.

benefits.title: No Restrictions on Number of Employees
benefits.description: Hire as many employees as your business requires with no visa quota limitations.

benefits.title: Government Contract Eligibility
benefits.description: Bid on lucrative federal and municipal government contracts and projects.

benefits.title: Unlimited Office Space Options
benefits.description: Secure office space of any size across Dubai to scale your operations.

limitations.title: Local Sponsor May Be Required
limitations.description: For certain restricted activities, a local Emirati sponsor holding 51% shares may still be needed.

limitations.title: Higher Setup Costs
limitations.description: Mainland setup typically involves higher initial costs compared to free zone alternatives.

limitations.title: More Regulatory Compliance
limitations.description: Subject to DED regulations, municipal approvals, and additional compliance requirements.

FreeZone.title: Free Zone Company Setup
FreeZone.subtitle: 100% foreign ownership, tax exemptions, and fast-track licensing across 50+ specialized free zones.
FreeZone.p1: With more than fifty Free Zones in the UAE, each catering to specific industries and business activities, free zone company formation offers 100% foreign ownership, full repatriation of capital and profits, and complete tax exemptions. Free zones are ideal for trading, services, technology, media, logistics, and holding companies that do not require direct access to the UAE mainland market.
FreeZone.p2: Each free zone has its own regulatory authority, licensing framework, and fee structure. Choosing the right free zone depends on your business activity, office space requirements, and visa needs — our team helps you compare and select the optimal jurisdiction.

benefits.title: 100% Repatriation of Capital & Profits
benefits.description: Full ownership and the ability to repatriate all capital and profits without restriction.

benefits.title: 0% Corporate & Personal Tax
benefits.description: Enjoy complete tax exemptions on corporate income and personal earnings.

benefits.title: No Currency Restrictions
benefits.description: Operate freely in AED, USD, EUR, and other currencies with no capital controls.

benefits.title: Fast-Track Licensing
benefits.description: Streamlined setup process with licenses often issued within days.

benefits.title: World-Class Infrastructure
benefits.description: Purpose-built business parks with state-of-the-art facilities and connectivity.

benefits.title: Visa Quotas Based on Office Space
benefits.description: Flexible visa allocations proportional to your leased office area.

limitations.title: Cannot Trade Directly on Mainland
limitations.description: Free zone companies cannot directly trade with the UAE mainland market without a local distributor or agent.

limitations.title: Restricted to Free Zone Premises
limitations.description: Operations must be physically located within the designated free zone boundary.

dmcc.description: DMCC is the dedicated global centre for more than 18,000 businesses, located in the heart of Dubai's JLT district. Recognised as the world's leading free zone for multiple consecutive years, DMCC offers a world-class ecosystem for commodities trading, crypto, finance, and professional services.

dso.description: DSO is a globally recognized free zone and an integrated technology park located in Dubai Silicon Oasis. It provides a comprehensive ecosystem for technology, engineering, and innovation-driven companies, combining residential, commercial, and industrial zones in one community.
features: Smart city amenities and R&D facilities

Offshore.title: Offshore Company Setup
Offshore.subtitle: Offshore Company Formation with UAE Bank Account. We maintain highest privacy standards.
Offshore.p1: Offshore companies offer a legitimate approach to wealth management, asset protection, and international holding structures. An offshore company registered in the UAE or another jurisdiction can own assets, hold intellectual property, and serve as a parent company for international operations — all while benefiting from tax efficiency, confidentiality, and a UAE bank account.
Offshore.p2: We assist with the full lifecycle of offshore company formation, from jurisdiction selection and registration to ongoing compliance and bank account opening. Our highest priority is maintaining privacy and confidentiality standards throughout the process.
Offshore.privacyNote: Privacy & Compliance: We operate in full compliance with international regulations while maintaining the highest standards of client confidentiality.

ajman.description: Established in 1988 as one of the first free zones in the UAE, Ajman Offshore provides a cost-effective and efficient offshore company registration option within the UAE. It is widely used for holding structures, asset protection, and international trading.
features: Eligible for UAE corporate bank account

bvi.description: The British Virgin Islands (BVI) is the world's leading and most popular offshore centre, with over 400,000 incorporated companies. BVI Business Companies are widely used for international holding, trading, and investment structures, offering flexibility, tax neutrality, and a well-established legal framework.
features: Flexible share structure and no minimum capital

seychelles.description: With its favourable tax policies, Seychelles has increasingly become a preferred business destination for international entrepreneurs. Seychelles International Business Companies (IBCs) offer tax exemption on foreign income, minimal reporting requirements, and a fast incorporation process.

FinancialCentre.title: Financial Centre Setup
FinancialCentre.subtitle: World-class financial jurisdictions for banks, fintech, investment firms, and professional services.
FinancialCentre.p1: The UAE has two specialist free zones focusing on the financial sector: the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM). Both operate as independent jurisdictions with their own legal systems based on common law, their own courts, and dedicated regulatory authorities — making them the premier destinations for financial institutions, fintech companies, investment firms, and professional services in the region.
FinancialCentre.p2: These financial centres provide an internationally recognised regulatory framework, a common-law legal system, and access to a deep pool of financial talent — ideal for banks, asset managers, insurance firms, and fintech innovators.

difc.description: A leading financial hub in the Middle East, Africa and South Asia (MEASA) region. DIFC is home to 25,000+ professionals and 2,400+ active entities, offering an independent common-law legal system, a world-class regulatory framework, and a thriving ecosystem for finance, fintech, and professional services.
features: DFSA regulatory framework aligned with global standards

adgm.description: Well-organized and favorable business environment for finance companies. ADGM, located in Abu Dhabi, operates on English common law and offers a robust regulatory framework through the FSRA, making it an attractive jurisdiction for banks, asset managers, fintech firms, and holding companies.

FreelanceLicenseAbuDhabi.title: Freelance License – Abu Dhabi
FreelanceLicenseAbuDhabi.subtitle: Practice your profession independently in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi. Obtain a freelance licence to carry out your professional activities independently under approved activities, in accordance with the highest standards and requirements for doing business. This licence is designed to be the optimal choice for specialists and highly experienced professionals in technical, digital, marketing, creative, and consulting fields.
FreelanceLicenseAbuDhabi.eligibilityAlertTitle: Are You Eligible for a Freelance Licence?
FreelanceLicenseAbuDhabi.eligibilityAlertText: Please note that the freelance licence is not a general option suitable for all individuals or all business activities. Eligibility depends primarily on the nature of the activity to be practiced, as well as academic qualifications, professional experience record, and supporting documents required. At Al Reyada Al Motaqadima, we conduct a thorough review of your activity, qualifications, and documents before initiating any procedures, to ensure full confirmation of your suitability and compliance with the licence issuance requirements.
FreelanceLicenseAbuDhabi.whatIsItTitle: What is the Abu Dhabi Freelance Licence?
FreelanceLicenseAbuDhabi.whatIsItText: The freelance licence is a legally recognised licence dedicated exclusively to specialists and skilled professionals who aspire to practice their professional activities independently in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi within a specific list of approved activities. This licence grants you full legal authority to provide your services to companies and individuals, manage your business freely, and build a broad client base in accordance with the legal framework and requirements applicable in the Emirate.

GoldenVisa.eligibilityText: Real estate investment: The applicant must own a property in the UAE valued at a minimum of 2,000,000 AED (either outright or via an approved mortgage plan).
